hazards.evidence: Everyday dishes/bowls stacked on high open shelves along the upper-left wall, requiring overhead reaching.
Freestanding step stool/small ladder near the rear counter that could be used to reach high shelves.
White cord/wire trailing and looping across the kitchen floor walkway (center to lower-right).
Central walkway between counters is occupied by a large pet bed, two bowls, scattered toys/bones and a cord, narrowing the path needed for a walker.
Room is dim overall with harsh sunlight glare and deep shadows across the floor, which can obscure the cord and items underfoot.
Pet bed, food/water bowls and multiple dog toys/bones on the floor in the main walking area.
